body: Integration-owner rule (Fable2 #5211, 2026-11-09). When swapping ui/dist in the master checkout, put the backup of the old dist under .tmp/, never as a sibling like ui/dist.<date>-before-<c8>.bak/. An untracked directory in the tracked tree makes the master checkout dirty, and `engram source` hashes it, so no committed-input run from master can be clean. Remove the backup once the new UI has served and no open item records a need for it, after the path check.
